experiences.title: Full Stack Web Developer Intern
experiences.subtitle: Online Internship Program
workDescription: Completed an intensive **3-month online Full Stack Web Development internship** gaining hands-on industry experience.
Designed and built dynamic, responsive front-end user interfaces using **React.js**, **HTML5**, and **CSS3**.
Developed backend logic, managed database interactions with **MongoDB / SQL**, and integrated RESTful APIs.
Practiced modular code architecture, version control with **Git**, and deployed modern web applications to **Vercel**.
